$comment: The trees and patterns are edited here. Every `recorded` block is written by scripts/record-glob-golden.mjs, on exactly the Node named below, and never by hand.

plain.why: every construct a consumer writes, over names that look like glob syntax — the same answer on every platform

case.why: win32 and darwin ignore case in a wildcard segment and ask the disk about a literal one; posix never ignores it

links.why: a pnpm install is a tree of directory links: `**` never enters one, so `**/*.md` reads no dependency — but a segment after `**` that names a link is followed one level (`**/*` reaches `node_modules/pkg/README.md`), as Node 24.21 does and Node 26.9 stopped doing

file-links.why: a link to a file is a file; a link to nothing is nothing — posix only, where no elevation is needed to make one

unreadable.why: a directory nobody may read: a wildcard skips it, a literal inside it is an error — posix only, and never as root
